corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez Gospel of John 1:41 accusative construct form is 'እኀዊሁ' (his brother), and the 3rd-order Fidel 'ዊ' is visible in the print.
In John 7:34, the plural verb 'ተኀሥሡኒ' (you will seek me) matches 'ወኢትረክቡኒ', and the 2nd-order vowel mark on 'ሡ' is clearly printed.
